verdict.rationale: Conductor orchestrates natural-language coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenCode) in per-task workspaces with a terminal, and those agents can test repositories and run builds. It also surfaces failing-check logs, so debugging via chat prompts is implied rather than documented as a feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language debugging/troubleshooting workflows, Conductor-native diagnostic tooling beyond delegating to third-party agents, hands-on or independent corroboration of debugging use.
